info.title: Crexendo Universal API
info.description: Crexendo provides NS API-powered cloud communications and contact-center operations for domains, users, devices, calling, contacts, messaging, meetings, and numbering.

get.description: Checks whether a domain exists in Crexendo.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain identifier, for example apps.mindcloud.co.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
